about: I'm Raiga — a player who treats games as more than a pastime. From climbing the osu! leaderboards to clutching rounds in VALORANT, every session adds a page to the story.
This page is a living snapshot of that story: real stats pulled from official APIs where possible, honest manual entries where it isn't, and nothing invented in between.

overview.note: Playtime data is not reliably available, so it is shown as unavailable rather than estimated.
